records.title: Mechanical Mechanism and Finite Element Analysis of Laminated Slab with Split-Joint under Uniform Load
records.summary: This study investigates the effect of close-fitting joints on the load-transfer and structural behaviour of composite concrete slabs. Six full-scale specimens and ABAQUS finite element models were used to examine stiffness, deflection, cracking, support reactions and failure mechanisms. The findings support conservative two-way slab design methods.

records.title: Seismic Behavior of an Inter-story Hinged Lateral Resistance Braced Frame
records.authors: Yu Ren, Yujun Wu, Peitao Xu
